notes.title: Graphics Settings & Performance FAQ
notes.content:
[p][b]• What should I do if the game crashes during shader compilation?[/b][/p][p]According to user reports, certain Intel 13th/ 14th-gen CPUs can become unstable at full load; in rare cases the shader compiler then reports “Out of video memory.”[/p][p]We recommend down-clocking the CPU with [url="https://www.intel.cn/content/www/cn/zh/download/17881/intel-extreme-tuning-utility-intel-xtu.html"]Intel’s official XTU utility[/url] (see Intel or your motherboard vendor for instructions) or reducing the “Maximum processor state” percentage in Windows Power Options > Advanced settings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• I’m using an AMD RX 6000-series GPU. Why can’t I enable ray tracing?
[/b]The RX 6000 series is AMD’s first-generation ray-tracing hardware; its RT performance is limited and enabling it would heavily impact frame-rates. We therefore restrict ray tracing on these cards. Even on some newer GPUs only a low RT preset is available to keep the game running smoothly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• My PC hardware is mid-range. How can I run the game smoothly? [/b][/p][p]The title automatically detects your hardware and applies a graphics preset that we have fully tested for smooth performance—only change it if necessary.[/p][p][/p][p]If you need higher FPS, try lowering “Super Sampling Quality,” “Shadow Quality,” and other options that heavily impact performance. In our tests, “Low Latency Mode” can reduce FPS on certain configurations; we recommend comparing on/off to see which feels smoother.[/p][p][/p][p]The Frame Generation feature (Settings → Graphics page) usually boosts FPS, but on some weaker GPUs or high-resolution displays it can occasionally reduce performance; we recommend toggling it on and off to see which feels smoother.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Additionally, the following steps may also help improve the game’s overall performance:[/b] [/p][p]- Keeping Windows fully updated to prevent compatibility issues. [/p][p]- Installing the game on a fast SSD and leaving 15–20 % free space to avoid speed drops. [/p][p]- Updating to the latest GPU driver. [/p][p]- Close unnecessary background applications. Some screen-recording, video-playback, or anti-virus software may reduce performance.[/p]

notes.title: Китайский фанфик по мотивам Final Fantasy: Обзор Lost Soul Aside
notes.content: На создание игры мечты у китайского фаната-одиночки Яна Бина ушло около 11 лет. Фанатский проект Lost Soul Aside был вдохновлён концептуальной глубиной Final Fantasy и зрелищными боями Devil May Cry пополам с динамикой Ninja Gaiden. Пробиться в высшую лигу энтузиасту помогла поддержка Sony в рамках инициативы China Hero Project. Под конец изнурительного марафона Бин уже руководил командой из 40 человек и умудрился облысеть, но всё же довёл игру мечты до релиза.

notes.title: Patch Installation Instructions (September 5, 2025)
notes.content: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]We are planning to release patches frequently in the near future. If you notice an unusually patch size, or experience stuttering, crashes, or failure to launch after an update, please use Steam’s “Verify Integrity of Game Files” function to check the game files, then restart your computer and launch the game again. Also double-check that the “Display” and “Graphics” settings have not set to unexpected values.[/p][p][/p][p]Our game automatically detects your hardware and applies a tested graphics preset; please treat manual changes with caution. If your framerate is low, try lowering “Super Sampling Quality,” “Shadow Quality,” and other options that heavily impact performance. In our tests, “Low Latency Mode” can reduce FPS on certain configurations; we recommend comparing on/off to see which feels smoother.[/p][p][/p][p]The Frame Generation feature (Settings → Graphics page) usually boosts FPS, but on some weaker GPUs or high-resolution displays it can occasionally reduce performance; we recommend toggling it on and off to see which feels smoother.[/p][p][/p][p]Keep your GPU drivers and Windows fully updated, and close unnecessary background applications. Some screen-recording, video-playback, or anti-virus software may reduce performance.[/p][p][/p][p]This update requires shader re-compile. If the game crashes during shader compilation, please try restart the game and allow the process to finish.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience and support![/p][p][/p][p]Lost Soul Aside Development Team[/p][p]September 5, 2025[/p]

notes.title: Lost Soul Aside system requirements suggest Sony's upcoming RPG is a breeze to run, but you may want to make some room on your SSD
notes.content: Lost Soul Aside, the upcoming Sony-published action RPG with a bit of a Square Enix look and feel, got a brand new preorder trailer in Sony's last live stream. With it just months out, the Sony blog has officially confirmed the Lost Soul Aside system requirements, and it's not too bad on hardware, even if the 16GB of RAM and SSD requirement may be a bit of a stretch for some older rigs... Read more.

notes.title: Lost Soul Aside, a spectacle fighter where your dragon pal turns into a hoverboard, is coming out in May
notes.content: The trailer for Lost Soul Aside shown at Sony's State of Play showcase really buries the lede. A girl dreams about an invasion of monsters, but you're the chosen one and official only hope, blah blah blah. Your best friend is a floating crystal dragon head who sounds like he's doing a Liam Neeson impersonation, and he says some stuff about your destiny. One minute in I was already stifling a yawn... Read more.
